eventDetail.scope: IEEE International Conference on Advanced Trends in Radioelectronics, Telecommunications and Computer Engineering (TCSET) is a part of IEEE Lviv Polytechnic Winter Week and one of major scientific event for IEEE community of the Lviv Polytechnic National University. IEEE TCSET focused on Signal Processing, Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies, Computational Intelligence, Aerospace and Electronic Systems, Photonics, Micro- and Nanoelectronics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering and Antennas, Microwave Technology and Electromagnetic Compatibility.
